body.mechanism: The exact eligible COG can be safely decoded without tag 42113 only if every actually used full-resolution value is finite/plausible and two independent geometry traversals reproduce the frozen 1,152-entry Sx lookup exactly.
body.treatment: Local-only typed nodata recovery on the exact N20 body; formula, geometry, values and object identity unchanged.
body.control: No refetch, fill, formula change, weather row, fit, policy, score or comparison.
body.metric: Boolean input, metadata, coverage, parity, finite/plausible-value, round-trip and determinism gates.
